notes: Search tool is US-focused; the NHS 111 Wales page, NHS treatment page and Versus Arthritis drugs pages returned only as titles or blended summaries, so many first-pass attributions to them could not be confirmed and were reworded to retrieved text. Atypical femoral fracture duration and ASBMR reassessment statements came from blended summaries of PMC results; attribution to PMC13110635/PMC4906542 is probable but not certain. First-pass sentence 13 (DXA does not predict fractures perfectly) sits in mild tension with the existing entry (NIAMS: DXA most reliable way to predict risk); final text uses a softer research-review sentence. No T-score cut-offs, doses or ages included in final. Final adds one textbook sentence (999 as UK emergency number) so urgency has a route to care. Raloxifene, calcitonin, HRT and teriparatide failure criteria dropped as unretrieved. First draft's PMC6741378, PMC5101006, PMC6679098, NIAMS BMD-adjacent NHS DEXA what-happens URLs, and Versus bisphosphonate/teriparatide pages were not returned by my searches and were dropped (Versus drugs-for-osteoporosis was only returned as a title).
